areas.title: Corporate Law
areas.description: We advise companies on governance, restructuring, mergers and acquisitions, due diligence and risk management, so their operations are strong and compliant.
areas.intro: Governance, restructuring, M&A, due diligence and risk management, so operations are strong and compliant.

areas.title: Competition Law
areas.description: We help businesses comply with competition rules, prevent unfair trade practices, and represent clients before regulatory authorities in competition and state aid matters.
areas.intro: Compliance with competition rules, unfair trade practices, and representation before the regulator.
services: Impact of competition law on your business

areas.title: Business & Property Law
areas.description: We support businesses by structuring contracts, protecting assets, managing property matters, and safeguarding their legal and financial interests.
areas.intro: Protecting the rights, assets and interests of Kosovan and foreign clients in their business and property.

areas.title: Tax Law
areas.description: We provide tax advice on transactions, direct and indirect tax compliance, and represent clients in disputes with the Tax Administration and Customs.
areas.intro: Tax advice on transactions, direct and indirect tax compliance, and disputes with the Tax Administration and Customs.

areas.title: Energy Law
areas.description: We advise on regulatory and market frameworks governing electricity generation, distribution, renewable energy, and energy market operations.
areas.intro: The legislative and institutional framework of the Kosovo electricity sector and its markets.

areas.title: Public Procurement
areas.description: We assist clients in meeting participation requirements, preparing proposals, and representing them in procurement objection procedures.
areas.intro: Meeting participation requirements, preparing proposals and pursuing objections.

areas.title: Labor Law
areas.description: We guide employers through employment matters, regulatory compliance, internal policies and disciplinary decisions, and represent them in labor disputes.
areas.intro: Employment matters, internal policies and disciplinary decisions, and representation in labor disputes.

areas.title: Family Law
areas.description: We provide strategic and considerate legal support in divorce, custody, support, property division and other family matters.
areas.intro: Strategic and considerate support at important moments in people’s lives.

areas.title: Litigation
areas.description: We represent clients in disputes with strategic, cost-effective solutions, pursuing the best possible outcome through negotiation or court proceedings.
areas.intro: We seek to avoid court where possible; where litigation is unavoidable, we manage it carefully and cost-efficiently.
